描述_EN: the surface of this example is decorated with three taotie (zoomorphic masks) and a band of cicada set against a background of spirals. this kind of bronze vessel, called in chinese li ding, was used for rituals celebrating the ancestors during the shang dynasty (1700-1050 bc), and was often buried in graves.
描述_ZN: 这个例子的表面装饰着三个饕餮（放大的面具）和一条以螺旋形为背景的蝉带。 这种青铜器在中国被称为礼鼎，在商代（公元前1700-1050年）被用于庆祝祖先的仪式，并经常被埋在坟墓里。
